records.title: A Study of Pembrolizumab in People With Ultra-Rare Sarcomas
NRSTS2021, A Risk Adapted Study Evaluating Maintenance Pazopanib, Limited Margin, Dose-Escalated Radiation Therapy and Selinexor in Non-Rhabdomyosarcoma Soft Tissue Sarcoma (NRSTS)

evidence.claim: ClinicalTrials.gov lists NCT07089992 as RECRUITING (Phase 2, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center) with U.S. sites in Basking Ridge, NJ; Middletown, NJ; Montvale, NJ; Commack, NY; and Harrison, NY.
ClinicalTrials.gov lists NCT06239272 as RECRUITING (Phase 1/2, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital) with U.S. sites in Atlanta, GA; Chicago, IL; Baton Rouge, LA; Boston, MA; and St Louis, MO.
